expectations.text: The main HTML contains direct links to report.html, qa.json, run.webm, and trace.zip using real relative paths.
The primary video run.webm is visible in the main body through a video element with controls and is not only inside a details element.
The output does not invent links or include unrelated artifacts that were not provided by the prompt or fixture directory.
The page includes source project absolute path and a Pi session ID in its footer.
